evidence.note: assertExclusiveModeFlags fails onConflict when write and check are both true; the helper exists to reject that combination.
syncGeneratedFile then branches write versus check-mode; both-true is never a handled combined-true case.

notes: Payload-free mode literal write|check (neither is accepted by the helper and later treated as check).

disqualifier.note: Four independent CLI switches; Flags.ts documents that --force and --dry-run are independent and a command given both should preview rather than destroy. All 16 combinations are legal config.

Single present gate with always-required lines/error; the JSDoc constructor uses present:false with a dummy error, and command callers set present from independent nonempty checks. Both values are supported, so this is not a masked union.
